decisions.quote: Willingness to change, generational involvement, perceived technological opportunities and corporate entrepreneurship for the Indian family business community, along with strategic planning, as a moderating factor, formed the earlier model. In the context of strategic planning, this study observes a similarity, but due to the consideration of the additional moderator, the role of generational involvement has become insignificant.
decisions.reason: The shipped quote only describes the earlier model without stating the replication result, whereas the next sentence explicitly reports partial agreement (similarity in strategic planning) and partial divergence (generational involvement becoming insignificant), which codes as mixed.
